characters.notes: Narrator/protagonist. He visits the sisters' social circle with Nihat and becomes deeply interested in Müjgân.
Young woman living in a dependent/sheltered position within the household. Pertev is strongly drawn to her mysterious, proud, and melancholic character.
Pertev's friend. He introduces Pertev to the three sisters and explains their social/gambling world.
One of the three sisters described as 'le truva gras'. She is socially active, flirtatious, and closely associated with Nihat.
One of the three sisters. She appears calmer and more controlled, especially in gambling scenes.
The youngest or liveliest of the three sisters. She is energetic, playful, and often teasing.
Officer/zabit figure associated with Nigâr in the social and dancing scenes.
Later female figure observed by Pertev; described as lively and energetic.
Süheyla Hanım's elder sister, briefly described in a dining/social scene.
Husband of Nebile Hanım; appears in a later social/dining scene.
